title: An issue opened with a person assigned starts no issue worker run, and the janitor gives it no-auto-processing without a word
covers: an issue opened with a person (the runner's own account) among its assignees and no bot among them starts no issue worker run, although only the hold is on it: the issue worker's condition has no term for the hold, so the assignee term of record 0043 is the only thing that can stop the opened event
the janitor's assigned job gives such an issue no-auto-processing, with the workflow token and no comment, although the hold is on it: the hold is not an outcome of the plan gate
nothing else the Concierge does touches it: no comment, no other label, no failed run, no pull request, and the assignee stays

not covered: handing the issue back by removing the label (scenario 5 does it, and it costs a model run), and the coding agent as an assignee (it starts a real coding session and costs a pull request; the unit tests cover the bot case)

issue.title: listWidgets: accept a limit for the number of names returned
issue.body:
## Proposal

Let `listWidgets` take an optional limit, for example `listWidgets(widgets, 3)`, and return only the first three widgets of the sorted list. Without it, nothing changes.

## Acceptance

- A test that asks for 2 of 4 widgets and gets the first two by name.

checks.name: the janitor gave the issue the opt-out label
the issue worker left no comment
the Concierge added no label but the opt-out
the assignee is still the runner's person
